justification: Removes 31 hand-typed bush fire coverage percentages from public council pages and their FAQs; no measured source exists for them.

pre_impl.existing_data: What existing data/state does this interact with? [table/column or 'none']
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: What if existing data doesn't match assumptions? [specific failure]
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: Will this apply to existing rows or only new? [mechanism]
pre_impl.external_source_error: (Critical only) What does external source return on error?
pre_impl.frontend_type: (Critical only) Does frontend type need updating?
pre_impl.user_failure_mode: (Critical only) What does user see if this fails?

functions.name: BushfireLgaPage (app/(tools)/bushfire/[lga-slug]/page.tsx)
functions.input: one council record looked up by slug
functions.output: page header and two data tiles, no coverage %
functions.if_none: unknown slug calls notFound() as before

functions.name: BushfireLgaData
functions.input: static council records typed in this file
functions.output: name, slug, vegetation, related slugs, FAQs
functions.if_none: n/a static data; a missing field fails tsc

break_it.what_happens: the page would render undefined percent text
break_it.how: field removed from the type, so tsc fails on any reader; grep finds none

break_it.scenario: an FAQ still claims a coverage %
break_it.what_happens: a visitor reads a made-up coverage percentage
break_it.how: grep returns nothing; scanner shows 0 unlisted

break_it.scenario: grid layout breaks with two tiles
break_it.what_happens: an empty third column shows in the tile row

falsifiable_check.fails_when: a typed coverage % is still in bushfire-lgas.ts but not in the ledger
falsifiable_check.observed_red: ledger listed 22 bfplCoveragePct entries open; scanner now reports 406 open (was 437)
